_: Bounds the compare table is held to. All three are absolute limits: 'median' caps the magnitude of the signed median, 'abs_median' caps the median absolute error, which is the one that can fail when errors of opposite sign cancel, and 'p90' caps the 90th percentile of that absolute error, which is the one that can fail when a minority of rows is far out and the median is not. A dimension can sit inside both medians while nearly half its rows are outside the references' own spread. 'rows' is how many of the grid's rows survived censoring into that median, so a later run can tell whether it is comparing against the same population. Re-record only in the same change as the behaviour that justifies it.
_pitch_motion_reading: tnr.abs_median (was 11.05), tnr.median (was 6.987) deleted 2026-10-23 and re-recorded when the tone-to-noise mask and the partial-level windows began widening, where no vibrato line is read, by the held excursion of the demodulated fundamental: twice the 99th percentile of its power-weighted distance from the mean pitch over the note's held part (0.3 s in to 0.15 s before the end), at the rate under which nine tenths of the motion lies, and 10 cents peak to peak at least. This reference's held pitch moves: an excursion reads on 16 of 28 rows, median 37 c at 6.9 Hz, detuned layers beating. The held pitch is not moved by it, so a still tone, a drift, a vibrato and the tuning read as they did.
_pitch_ruler: raised on 2026-10-24 when the held pitch moved from the strongest peak to the power centroid of each partial's lines (metrics_partials.line_centroid_pitch), and every reference was re-measured with it: tnr.abs_median 19.2 -> 24.056, stretch.abs_median 5.35 -> 8.498, stretch.median 1.2 -> 3.439. The old bounds were recorded from a reading that picked one of a partial's detuned lines by the window's beat phase, or placed the windows that the other readings take from f0 on that line.
_beat_phase_arrival: attack.abs_median (was 50.0) deleted 2026-10-25 and re-recorded when the pad became two layers of a chorused narrow pulse. Both sides beat through the held note, 3.1-3.4 dB (reference) and 2.6-3.2 dB (model) around their own trend, as deep as the 3 dB slack the arrival is read within, so the arrival lands on whichever beat crest comes first: moving the attack 120 -> 130 ms flips C6 from -135 to +60 ms. The signed median stays inside its bound.
_module_split: Every bound but vel_range was deleted when this slot's colour and behaviour moved to `pad_metallic_module` (stretch, tnr, damper, attack, balance, centroid_pct, body, register); they held the voice to the library's sound, which `policy.json` does not aim a machine-defined slot at.
